_about: MURAVES reconstruction parameters used by BOTH the data and the simulation chains. Each value is defined only here: chain-specific parameters live in configuration/data/ and configuration/simulation/ and may not redefine these sections. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the code.

detector_geometry._note: Plane positions per telescope: z_add (vertical offsets) and x_pos (plane distances).

strips._note: Strip geometry of one plane: position of the first strip, strip pitch and number of strips.
